options.name: advanced
options.description: Additional HAProxy options to include in the global settings area.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: carpdev
options.description: The CARP interface IP to monitor. HAProxy will only run on the firewall whose interface is MASTER.

options.name: dns_resolvers
options.description: The DNS resolvers HAProxy will use for DNS queries.

options.name: email_from
options.description: The email address to be used as the sender of the emails.

options.name: email_level
options.description: The maximum log level to send emails for. Leave empty to disable sending email alerts.

options.name: email_mailers
options.description: The email servers HAProxy will use to send SMTP alerts.

options.name: email_myhostname
options.description: The hostname to use as the origin of the email.

options.name: email_to
options.description: The email address to send emails to.

options.name: enable
options.description: Enables or disable HAProxy on the system.

options.name: enablesync
options.description: Enables or disables including HAProxy configurations in HA sync if configured.

options.name: hard_stop_after
options.description: The maximum time allowed to perform a clean soft-stop. This can be represented as different time values such as 30s, 15m, 3h or 1d.

options.name: localstats_refreshtime
options.description: The internal (in seconds) in which local stats will be refreshed.

options.name: localstats_sticktable_refreshtime
options.description: The internal (in seconds) in which the sticktable stats will be refreshed.

options.name: localstatsport
options.description: The internal port to be used for the stats tab. Set to null to disable local stats. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: log_send_hostname
options.description: The hostname field to include in the syslog header. Leave empty to use the system hostname.

options.name: logfacility
options.description: The logging facility to log to.

options.name: loglevel
options.description: The log level to begin logging events. Only events of this level or higher will be logged.

options.name: maxconn
options.description: The maximum per-process number of concurrent connections

options.name: nbthread
options.description: The number of threads to start per process. This setting is experimental.

options.name: remotesyslog
options.description: The IP address or hostname of the remote syslog server to send logs to. Use `/var/run/log` to to log to the local pfSense system log.

options.name: resolver_holdvalid
options.description: The interval between two successive name resolution when the last answer was valid.

options.name: resolver_retries
options.description: The number of queries to send to resolve a server name before giving up.

options.name: resolver_timeoutretry
options.description: The time between two DNS queries, when no response have been received.

options.name: sslcompatibilitymode
options.description: The SSL/TLS compatibility mode which determines the cipher suites and TLS versions supported.

options.name: ssldefaultdhparam
options.description: The maximum size of the Diffie-Hellman parameters used for generating the ephemeral/temporary Diffie-Hellman key in case of DHE key exchange

options.name: terminate_on_reload
options.description: Enables or disables an immediate stop of old process on reload. (closes existing connections)

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
